_comment: === prompt_config.json TEMPLATE === Read this entire file before filling. Keep all fields. Replace values inside <...> placeholders. Delete _comment fields in the final output.
_resolution_comment: 2560x1440 or 2048x1152 for screenshots; 1024x1024 for non-screenshot. Must match all images.
_output_dir_comment: Relative to the run directory. Created automatically if missing.
_upstream_count_comment: Number of upstream API providers. Use 1 for single-upstream; 2+ for parallel sharding.
_upstream_index_comment: 0-based index when running sharded. Leave at 0 for single-upstream mode.
_max_workers_comment: Max concurrent API calls. Do not exceed 16.
_max_retries_comment: Retries per image on transient failure.
_timeout_comment: API timeout in seconds per image generation call.

image_policy._comment: Global policy applied to all images in this batch.
image_policy._default_mode_comment: 'screenshot_strict' for terminal/IDE/UI screenshots; 'generic' for non-screenshot images.
image_policy._auto_append_negative_comment: If true, negative prompts are auto-generated from forbidden_terms.
image_policy._fail_on_prompt_risk_comment: If true, validation failure blocks generation.
image_policy._probe_retries_comment: Number of upstream availability probe attempts.
image_policy._skip_existing_files_comment: If true, skip images that already exist in output_dir.
image_policy._forbidden_terms_comment: Terms that must not appear in any prompt. Extend as needed.
image_policy._crop_browser_chrome_comment: If true, prompts instruct the model to avoid browser chrome.
image_policy._forbid_localhost_or_dev_url_comment: If true, validation rejects localhost/dev URLs in prompts.

quality_constraints._comment: Post-generation quality checks. Keep all true unless you have a reason to relax one.
quality_constraints._consistency_comment: Cross-image environment, theme, and style consistency.
quality_constraints._no_blur_or_mosaic_comment: No haze, motion blur, or block/mosaic artifacts.

global_prompt: <unified environment description for all images: OS, theme, font, layout, style — do NOT describe individual image content here>
_global_prompt_comment: The global_prompt defines the SHARED visual environment. Individual image.prompt fields add per-image content on top of this. They must be semantically compatible. See examples/prompt_config.example.json for a working reference.

images._comment: === Image entry template. Copy this block for each image. Fields with <...> must be replaced. ===
images.name: img_01
images._name_comment: Must follow img_NN format: img_01, img_02, ... continuous numbers, no gaps.
images.prompt: <per-image content description — must be compatible with global_prompt. Describe what THIS specific image shows.>
images._reference_image_comment: OPTIONAL. Set to null for txt2img. Set to an absolute file path for img2img (editing/enhancing the reference). When non-null, the prompt should describe the DESIRED CHANGE (e.g., 'increase brightness, keep terminal layout identical'), not the full scene from scratch.

_images_comment: Each entry in images[] maps to one generated image. total_count must equal the length of this array. For img2img images, include reference_image; for txt2img, omit it. Mixing both modes in one batch is supported.
